snippet.title: Total Backfire | Pre-Alpha Gameplay Trailer.
snippet.description:
Total Backfire is a fast-paced roguelike shooter built around constant movement, explosive combat, and stylish characters.

Keep moving, slide through danger, use grenades, and fight your way through increasingly intense encounters.

This gameplay trailer showcases the current pre-alpha build of Total Backfire. Visuals, effects, UI, balance, and other elements are still a work in progress.

Developed in Unreal Engine 5 by Alien Tech Games.

🔥 Wishlist Total Backfire on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3759160/?snr=1_5_9__205

For publishing and business inquiries: atgamesconnect@gmail.com
